text:
priya: psionic13b-int4 canary hitting intermittent OOMs on dedicated nodes. Mostly long sessions (>800 tokens) after ~2h. Logs show 'alloc fail' from tiling allocator and high slab fragmentation. anyone seen this pattern with memory_tiling + heavy prefetch?
kevin: yep. aggressive prefetch + int4 KV layout causes slab churn. what are current canary defaults?
priya: canary config: `max_new_tokens=1024`, `batching.max_concurrent=8`, `prefetch_window=64`, `memory_tiling.enabled=true`, `memory_tiling.prefetch_bias=0.9`. repro ~6%.
maya: 0.9 is too aggressive for int4. that hoards KV slots and fragments slabs. drop prefetch_bias to 0.5 and reduce concurrency to 2 during rollout.
sam: also enable soft evict and set kv_trim_threshold=0.6 so we reclaim cleanly: `memory_tiling.soft_evict=true`, `memory_tiling.kv_trim_threshold=0.6`.
kevin: set `max_new_tokens=256` for this variant and enforce `client_max=1024` at route level. turn on per-request `kv_eviction="on-epoch"` to avoid unbounded growth.
priya: patch deployed to two canary hosts: prefetch_bias=0.5, max_new_tokens=256, batching.max_concurrent=2. monitoring.
infra-bot: deploy 6182600000 by priya to eng-dedicated-canary at 2024-11-05T16:12:24Z  success
sam: smoke earlier: bias=0.9 had similar P50 but P95 +200ms and heavy slab churn. bias=0.5 P95 down ~120ms and fragmentation traces cleaner.
maya: run quick eval on 100 long-summary samples comparing int4 vs int8. hold if Rouge/L delta > 1.5%.
priya: starting 24h canary + eval. if OOMs stop and quality delta <1% roll to 10% traffic.
kevin: add slot_reserve=0.08 to allocation policy to maintain headroom for hot allocs. saved us before.
priya: added slot_reserve 0.08. will post metric snapshots in ~2h. :thumbsup:
